title: DUI Picking Up Kid From School (Police Bodycam)
description:
On February 24th, 2023, officers responded to a 911 emergency. The caller advised that a parent had picked up their child from school and sped off in their vehicle in a disoriented manner. The caller followed the vehicle to their home and tried to contact the parents, but they didn’t want to talk. The female continued to act in an agitated manner. She kept abusing the officers and wasn’t ready to comply at all. The female tried to push the senior officer after which she was transported to the police unit. She continued to abuse and scream at the officers while being transported to jail. She showed no signs of stopping her abusive attitude towards the officers. The woman continued to behave rudely toward the police, refusing to comply with their orders at all. She wasn’t willing to come out of the police unit at all. The woman finally complied and walked inside the police department with the female officer. The female was charged with resisting arrest, aggravated battery upon a peace officer, reckless driving and endangering the life of a child.

About Us / Disclaimer: 

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
